entries.title: Five years of news cycles
entries.summary: How stories start, peak and fade across the whole archive: which categories fill the wire, how long a story lives, the shapes a news cycle takes, and who covers what. Built from every run since the first day of collection.
entries.definitions: A run is one pipeline execution, median 5 per day. An observation is a story seen in one run. Distinct counts unique story identities in a window. New counts stories on the first day they ever appeared. A source is an outlet as resolved by the source table. Volume series are era-normalized against a trailing 91-day median.
